```{r setup}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr)
  library(reactable); library(htmltools)
})

repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("run_pipeline.R"))
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

invisible(lapply(sort(list.files(file.path(repo_root, "R"),
                                 pattern = "^\\d+_.*\\.R$",
                                 full.names = TRUE)), source))
cfg_path <- params$config
if (!file.exists(cfg_path)) cfg_path <- file.path(repo_root, cfg_path)
cfg <- load_config(cfg_path)

rcfg <- modifyList(
  list(
    top_n_taxa              = 25,
    rank_taxa_by            = "prevalence_x_abundance",
    network_top_nodes       = 50,
    network_edge_min_weight = 0.3,
    show_per_group_chord    = TRUE,
    show_per_group_sankey   = TRUE
  ),
  cfg$report %||% list()
)

ds_root  <- file.path(cfg$project_root, cfg$outputs$datasets_dir)
fig_root <- file.path(cfg$project_root, cfg$outputs$figures_dir)
group    <- cfg$metadata$group_cols[[1]]
sid      <- cfg$metadata$sample_id_col

# ---- I/O helpers ------------------------------------------------------------

read_csv_safe <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(readr::read_csv(p, show_col_types = FALSE),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}
read_tsv_safe <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(readr::read_tsv(p, show_col_types = FALSE),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}
read_text_safe <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  paste(readLines(p, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
}
empty_card <- function(msg) htmltools::div(
  style = "padding:1rem;color:#666;font-style:italic;", msg
)
rt <- function(df, ...) {
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(empty_card("No data."))
  reactable::reactable(
    df, searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE,
    pagination = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 12,
    bordered = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, striped = TRUE,
    ...
  )
}

# Embed a pipeline-saved figure. img_card() inlines as <img> (base64'd by
# Quarto's embed-resources); link_card() emits an "open in new tab" link for
# artifacts that don't embed cleanly (htmlwidgets HTML referencing relative
# _files/ assets; very tall heatmaps that get squished in a dashboard card).
# Both fall back to an empty card when the file is missing so optional
# outputs don't blank-screen the dashboard.
img_card <- function(path, alt = "") {
  if (length(path) != 1 || is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    return(empty_card(sprintf("Missing: %s", basename(path %||% ""))))
  }
  # IMPORTANT: this helper is called both as a direct chunk return value
  # (parent is a Quarto card with a fixed height) and via
  # print(tagList(img_card(...))) inside `output: asis` loops (parent is
  # the bare document flow with no fixed height). `height: 100%` on the
  # wrapper would collapse to zero in the asis case and hide the image,
  # which is exactly the bug behind "chord per group is broken" and
  # "plots render too big". Use viewport-relative caps instead so both
  # contexts behave: the image scales to its container width and is
  # capped at 65vh regardless of parent height. The "Open full size"
  # link below opens the unconstrained PNG in a new tab.
  htmltools::div(
    style = paste(
      "display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;",
      "gap:0.35rem;padding:0.2rem;width:100%;"
    ),
    htmltools::img(
      src = path, alt = alt,
      style = paste(
        "max-width:100%;max-height:65vh;",
        "object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:auto;"
      )
    ),
    htmltools::a(
      href = to_relpath(path), target = "_blank",
      style = paste(
        "font-size:0.8rem;color:#0d6efd;text-decoration:none;",
        "white-space:nowrap;"
      ),
      htmltools::HTML("Open full size &nearr;")
    )
  )
}

# Path of the report's final destination — needed to build relative href
# values so links remain valid after run_pipeline.R copies report.html out
# of templates/ into cfg$outputs$report_html. We compute paths relative to
# this dir so the dashboard works whether opened from disk or shared.
report_dir <- normalizePath(
  file.path(cfg$project_root, dirname(cfg$outputs$report_html)),
  winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE
)
to_relpath <- function(abs_path) {
  a <- strsplit(normalizePath(abs_path,   winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), "/")[[1]]
  b <- strsplit(report_dir, "/")[[1]]
  i <- 1
  while (i <= length(a) && i <= length(b) && a[[i]] == b[[i]]) i <- i + 1
  ups <- rep("..", length(b) - i + 1)
  paste(c(ups, a[seq.int(i, length(a))]), collapse = "/")
}
# Small "Download CSV" anchor used above reactable tables so users can grab
# the source data file directly without copy-pasting the rendered grid.
csv_download_link <- function(path, label = NULL) {
  if (length(path) != 1 || is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  label <- label %||% sprintf("Download %s", basename(path))
  htmltools::div(
    style = "text-align:right;margin:0 0 0.4rem 0;",
    htmltools::a(
      href = to_relpath(path), download = basename(path),
      style = paste(
        "display:inline-block;padding:0.25rem 0.7rem;",
        "background:#f8f9fa;border:1px solid #ced4da;border-radius:4px;",
        "color:#0d6efd;text-decoration:none;font-size:0.85rem;"
      ),
      htmltools::HTML(sprintf("&darr; %s", label))
    )
  )
}

link_card <- function(path, label, description = NULL) {
  if (length(path) != 1 || is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    return(empty_card(sprintf("Missing: %s", basename(path %||% ""))))
  }
  htmltools::div(
    style = paste(
      "display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;",
      "justify-content:center;height:100%;padding:1.25rem;",
      "text-align:center;gap:0.5rem;"
    ),
    htmltools::h5(label, style = "margin:0;"),
    if (!is.null(description)) htmltools::p(
      description, style = "color:#666;margin:0;font-size:0.9rem;"
    ),
    htmltools::a(
      href = to_relpath(path), target = "_blank",
      style = paste(
        "display:inline-block;padding:0.45rem 1.1rem;",
        "background:#0d6efd;color:white;border-radius:4px;",
        "text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;"
      ),
      htmltools::HTML("Open in new tab &nearr;")
    ),
    htmltools::tags$small(
      htmltools::HTML(sprintf("<code>%s</code>", basename(path))),
      style = "color:#888;"
    )
  )
}

# Convert a slugified metric name back to a display label.
# "shannon_diversity_index" -> "Shannon Diversity Index"
prettify_metric <- function(s) {
  stringr::str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", s))
}

# Top-N taxa selector for the composition section. Reused from prior report.
top_features <- function(long, n, by = rcfg$rank_taxa_by,
                          feature_col = "feature", value_col = "value") {
  if (is.null(long) || !nrow(long)) return(character())
  s <- long |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[feature_col]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_abundance = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      max_abundance  = max(.data[[value_col]],  na.rm = TRUE),
      prevalence     = mean(.data[[value_col]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(prevalence_x_abundance = prevalence * mean_abundance)
  s <- s[order(-s[[by]]), ]
  head(s[[feature_col]], n)
}

    # stacked_bar.png. Prefer the new name, fall back to the legacy one so

    pick_first <- function(...) {
      for (p in c(...)) if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
      c(...)[[1]]

    list(
      relabu_png         = pick_first(
        file.path(fig_root, "relative_abundance", "relative_abundance.png"),
```

```{r}
# Shrink value-box fonts so longer values like "Treatment" stop overflowing
# the card. Also tighten the overall card padding.
cat('
<style>
/* Tighten value-box typography. Use very high specificity (html body … and
   p.value-box-value) because bslib/Quarto ship their own rules that
   otherwise win. The default sizes leave long values like "Treatment"
   overflowing the card. */
html body .value-box p.value-box-value,
html body .bslib-value-box p.value-box-value {
  font-size: 0.9rem !important;
  line-height: 1.1 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  text-overflow: ellipsis !important;
}
html body .value-box p.value-box-title,
html body .bslib-value-box p.value-box-title {
  font-size: 0.7rem !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  opacity: 0.85 !important;
}
html body .value-box .value-box-area {
  padding: 0.4rem 0.55rem !important;
  gap: 0.1rem !important;
}
html body .value-box .value-box-showcase { font-size: 1.2rem !important; }
</style>
')
```

```{r}
  long <- comp |>
    dplyr::select(sample, feature = name, value = percentage,
                  dplyr::any_of(group))
  keep <- top_features(long, rcfg$top_n_taxa)
  long |>
    dplyr::filter(feature %in% keep) |>
    dplyr::group_by(feature) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_pct = round(mean(value), 2),
                     max_pct  = round(max(value), 2),
                     prevalence = round(mean(value > 0), 3),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_pct)) |>
    rt()
}
```

```{r}
# Sort metrics by the slug embedded in the violin filename so the per-metric
# tabs come out in a stable order across runs. Each metric has a paired
# *_violin.png and *_bar.png produced by R/06.
alpha_metrics <- sort(sub("_violin\\.png$", "", basename(alpha_violin_files)))
```

## Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (!length(alpha_metrics)) {
  cat("::: {.card title='Alpha'}\nNo alpha-diversity figures found — was R/06 run?\n:::\n")
} else {
  for (m in alpha_metrics) {
    pretty <- prettify_metric(m)
    cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", pretty))
    cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
    cat("\n#### Violin\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(
      file.path(alpha_fig_dir, paste0(m, "_violin.png")),
      alt = pretty
    )))
    cat("\n\n#### Per-sample bar\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(
      file.path(alpha_fig_dir, paste0(m, "_bar.png")),
      alt = pretty
    )))
    cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
  }
  cat("\n\n### Table\n\n")
  alpha_disp <- dat$alpha
  if (!is.null(alpha_disp)) {
    # Show prettified metric column names in the table only — keep the CSV
    # on disk slugified so downstream tooling stays stable.
    rename_targets <- intersect(alpha_metrics, colnames(alpha_disp))
    if (length(rename_targets)) {
      new_names <- prettify_metric(rename_targets)
      colnames(alpha_disp)[match(rename_targets, colnames(alpha_disp))] <- new_names
    }
  }
  print(htmltools::tagList(rt(alpha_disp)))
}
```

```{r}
# The full ALDEx2 diagnostic PDFs (MA / MW / volcano, all pairs) are
# level-wide artefacts, not pair-specific, so they belong here as section
# downloads rather than inside the per-pair tabset. The wrapper fills the
# row (height:100%; box-sizing:border-box) so the inner padding has room

    "Taxa PDF"

)
```

## Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| output: asis

# R/08 emits a per-pair volcano PNG plus a multi-page aldex_plots.pdf.
# The PNG is shown inside each pair's sub-tabs; the PDF is offered as a
# section-header download above (one per level) instead of a redundant
# in-tab card.
render_daa_level <- function(level_label, bundle, level_short) {
  if (is.null(bundle$pair_files) || !length(bundle$pair_files)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\nNo ALDEx2 outputs found for %s.\n",
                level_label, level_label))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  fig_subdir <- file.path(fig_root, "differential_abundance", level_short)
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", level_label))
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  for (pf in bundle$pair_files) {
    cn <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(pf))
    df <- read_tsv_safe(pf)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) next
    cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n", cn))
    cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

    cat("\n##### Volcano\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(
      file.path(fig_subdir, paste0("volcano_", cn, ".png")),
      alt = sprintf("%s volcano", cn)
    )))

    cat("\n\n##### Candidates\n\n")
    cf <- file.path(dirname(pf), paste0("candidates_", cn, ".csv"))
    cdf <- read_csv_safe(cf)
    if (!is.null(cdf)) print(htmltools::tagList(rt(cdf)))
    else cat("No candidates CSV for this comparison.\n")

    cat("\n\n##### Full table\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(rt(df)))
    cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
  }
  cat("\n:::\n")
}

render_daa_level("Taxa",  dat$daa_taxa, "taxa")
render_daa_level("Genes", dat$daa_gene, "gene")
```

# Gene-element profiles

```{r}
#| include: false
# Render one panel-tabset per domain. Each domain re-uses the pipeline's
# saved PNG suite (utils_ge_profile.R writes the same shape for all three).
# Mobilome has the additional family-level views appended as a 6th tab.
render_ge_domain <- function(g) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", g$title))
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

  # ---- Alpha ----
  cat("\n#### Alpha\n\n")
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  if (length(g$alpha_violin)) {
    cat("\n##### Richness violin\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$alpha_violin[[1]])))
  }
  if (length(g$alpha_bar)) {
    cat("\n\n##### Per-sample bar\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$alpha_bar[[1]])))
  }
  cat("\n\n##### Abundance violin\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$abundance)))
  cat("\n\n##### Table\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(rt(read_csv_safe(g$alpha_csv))))
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n")

  # ---- Venn ----
  cat("\n\n#### Venn\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$venn)))

  # ---- Heatmaps ----
  cat("\n\n#### Heatmaps\n\n")
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  # Gene-level pheatmap can be hundreds of rows tall — link out so the
  # full resolution is reachable instead of crushed into a card.
  cat("\n##### Genes\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(link_card(
    g$pheatmap_genes,
    label = sprintf("%s — gene × sample heatmap", g$title),
    description = "Full-resolution PNG — opens in a new tab."
  )))
  cat(sprintf("\n\n##### %s\n\n", g$category_label))
  print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$pheatmap_category)))
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n")

  # ---- Composition ----
  # The "Total count" PNG already shows every category's total — the
  # underlying CSV was a separate redundant tab. Attach a CSV download
  # under the bar plot instead and drop the table tab.
  cat("\n\n#### Composition\n\n")
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  cat("\n##### Relative abundance\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$rel_abundance)))
  cat("\n\n##### Total count\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(
    img_card(g$total_count),
    csv_download_link(g$totals_csv,
                      sprintf("Download %s totals CSV", g$category_label))
  ))
  cat(sprintf("\n\n##### %s prevalence\n\n", g$category_label))
  print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$cat_prevalence)))
  # Skip the "Gene prevalence" tab when a domain doesn't have a separate
  # gene-level artifact (mobilome: category == gene == plasmid replicon).
  if (!is.null(g$gene_prevalence)) {
    cat("\n\n##### Gene prevalence\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$gene_prevalence)))
  }
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n")

  # ---- Beta ----
  cat("\n\n#### Beta\n\n")
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  cat("\n##### PCoA\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$pcoa)))
  cat("\n\n##### PERMANOVA\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(htmltools::pre(
    read_text_safe(g$permanova) %||% "beta_permanova.txt not found"
  )))
  cat("\n\n##### PERMDISP\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(htmltools::pre(
    read_text_safe(g$permdisp) %||% "beta_permdisp.txt not found"
  )))
  cat("\n\n##### Scores\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(rt(read_csv_safe(g$pcoa_csv))))
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n")

  # ---- Family (mobilome only) ----
  if (!is.null(g$family_rel)) {
    cat("\n\n#### Replicon families\n\n")
    cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
    cat("\n##### Relative abundance\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$family_rel)))
    cat("\n\n##### Total count\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(
      img_card(g$family_total),
      csv_download_link(g$family_totals_csv,
                        "Download replicon-family totals CSV")
    ))
    cat("\n\n##### Prevalence\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(img_card(g$family_prevalence)))
    cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
  }

  cat("\n\n:::\n")
}
```
